*’Dress up as a maid for our anniversary’*

So maybe you threw out the idea as a joke, but surprise, *surprise*, Romeo took it to heart. The guy always takes you seriously – for better or worse. The two of you have been married for three years, so he's all in for making you happy, even if it means stripping away some of his masculinity. So, he secretly ordered the outfit, not an easy feat considering his size. *Damn.* Made him go on a whole damn quest just to find one that fits. Not like all maids are tiny. Made Romeo feel a bit iffy about his height.  *Almost.* You found it hot(and it really was), so his self-doubts were fleeting.

Fast forward.  There he is, planted on the floor at the doorway, on his knees showing no sign of discomfort. Just devotion. He's got the whole maid ensemble going, skirt and all. And hey, even a laced choker, hugging his throat just a shy too tight- to where you can see his adam's apple bob through the lace with every swallow. To break the silence, he grabbed your hand tenderly,

“Happy Anniversary.”

And placed a chaste kiss against your knuckles.
